title: Unemployment Benefit Claims — Weekly Payable Amount Computation
content:
The weekly payable amount on an Unemployment Benefit Claims record is computed for the latest certified week of the claim, read by week ending date, from the figures on that week's certification and on the claim.

## Definition

The weekly payable amount is the weekly benefit amount plus the dependency allowance, less the earnings deduction and less the other-pay deduction, rounded down to the whole dollar, never below zero and never more than the remaining benefit balance.

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Earnings disregard | The program's disregard share of the weekly benefit amount, rounded to the cent |
| Earnings deduction | Every dollar of earnings above the disregard |
| Dependency allowance | Counts in full |
| Other-pay deduction | Vacation or holiday pay reported for the week in full; an employer-funded pension at the program's pension offset share; a claimant-contributed pension at the program's claimant-contributed share; each rounded to the cent; severance pay not deducted |

Both deductions are subtracted from the weekly benefit amount plus the dependency allowance in one step before rounding down.

## Weeks that pay nothing

- A week whose hours reach the program's full-time hours threshold pays nothing.
- On a claim whose program's waiting week count is above zero, nothing is payable while the claim carries fewer waiting-week entries than that count.

## Worked example (hypothetical week, Regular State Unemployment Insurance figures)

Weekly benefit amount 346.00, dependency allowance 15.00, remaining balance 5000.00; one waiting-week entry on the claim; the week reports 150.00 of earnings and 10.0 hours, with an employer-funded pension of 50.00.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Disregard: 0.30 times 346.00 | 103.80 |
| Earnings deduction: 150.00 less 103.80 | 46.20 |
| Other-pay deduction: 50.00 at the 1.00 share | 50.00 |
| 346.00 plus 15.00, less 46.20 and 50.00 | 264.80 |
| Weekly payable amount, rounded down | 264.00 |

With a remaining balance of 200.00 the payable amount would be 200.00.
